messages:
elaine: Quick thread to lock the partner-commitment signals + small pilot playbook. Need something operationable for CS/Eng by EOW.

sam: TL;DR: what exact signals = go vs pause vs escalate? I can wire alerts and a tiny webhook.

elaine: Go signals (candidate): 1) Activation: partner completes onboarding checklist and flips trial toggle; 2) Usage: >=1000 tokens/day or >=3 distinct API keys used; 3) Business: at least 1 signed intent-to-trial doc or PO; 4) Quality: core eval pass rate within 3% of baseline for 7 days. Need 3/4 to mark partner "on-path".

kai: UI idea: show a small "commitment meter" in partner view with green/yellow/red and the three top failing items. Also add single-click solicit MOU CTA.

nina: CS ops: include "blocking ask" boolean on intake so we can triage. Also require partners to nominate 1 technical owner + 1 product owner for weekly syncs.

sam: For alerts: I'll create webhook channels: `pilot-alerts` for ops and `pilot-escalate` for legal/sales when MOU-related changes occur. Will surface a `commitment_score` 0-100.

elaine: Pause gates: p95 latency >3x baseline for 6h OR sustained error-rate >7% for 4h OR critical eval regression (>5% hallucination delta) -> auto-pause new traffic + page on-call.

kai: Survey: 3 clicks + one textarea. Q1 overall thumbs up/down, Q2 did the partner accomplish core tasks (yes/no), Q3 blocker? (yes/no). Keep copy friendly.

nina: Cadence: weekly digest to partner + internal triage board every Friday. Monthly product deep-dive with top 5 asks. Also keep a public changelog for pilot partners.

sam: I'll add a small Slack alert flow: green -> no alert, yellow -> DM CS lead, red -> page eng-sre and mark thread for postmortem.

elaine: Owners: sam -> commit_score calc + webhooks (due Wed); kai -> commitment meter mock + CTA (Thu); nina -> intake field + digest template (Fri); I'll assemble the acceptance checklist and circulate.

deploy-bot: note: onboarding-template-2 deployed to staging at 2026-03-28T03:00Z.

elaine: If no objections I'll lock this and add to program README. This thread is canonical for partner commitment signals. Thanks :rocket:
